next_page_token.description: Parameter defines the next page token. It is used for retrieving the next page of results. Leave it unset for the first page. Up to `100` results are returned per page; Yahoo! may return fewer. The next page token can be found in the the API JSON response: `the API_pagination -> next_page_token`. It is only present while more results are available.

full_video_links.description: Parameter defines whether to include playable video links. It can be set to `true` to include a `full_video_link` for each topic video, or `false` (default) to skip them. Enabling it performs an additional request to Yahoo!, which may increase the search response time. Full video links expire after one hour. To retrieve fresh links, run a new search with the `no_cache` parameter enabled.

# Yahoo Trends

List trending searches on Yahoo right now, with topic, related links and videos.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/yahoo/trends" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{}'
```

The result is returned in `outputs[0].data` as structured JSON.
